description: The smoke planner should emit commands and files without starting Docker, running psql, or mutating a database.
The plan should only mark safe_to_smoke_apply when accepted pgvector load rows are nonzero and rejected rows are zero.
The command chain should start local pgvector, wait for health, initialize schema, apply embedding load SQL, export counts, and rerun committed-load audit.
The default DATABASE_URL should point to the local development pgvector container and be clearly separated from managed production targets.
